notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental. Top-level receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (p3-4); balance sheet uses the net position/assets section on p2 (statement of activities and net position; cash basis, no liabilities). Interfund transfers (114,552 General to Nutrition 74,552 and Activities 40,000) are eliminated in the Reclassifications column, so transfers_in/out are null at the top level and totals exclude them. The Total column splits the printed 'Other taxes' 105,463 into motor vehicle 101,418, carline 1,007 (939+68) and penalties/interest 3,038 (2,853+185) using the General Fund and Special Building schedules (p9, p16); 'Property taxes' 1,754,557 as printed excludes penalties. Hidden transfer: General Fund Components combining schedule (p7) shows Operation and maintenance of plant 510,524 with a (200,000) elimination (transfer to Depreciation Fund, p14); the General Fund budget schedule (p12) line items 2610-2630 sum to 510,524, so a contra line (-200,000) and an other financing line (-200,000) were added; printed GF expenditure total 4,282,764 = 3,968,212 items + 114,552 + 200,000 transfers? items listed sum 4,168,212 before the contra; with contra -200,000 and other financing 314,552 total equals 4,282,764. Detail: used the General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p9-12, with account codes and budget) for the General Fund and skipped the less detailed General Fund Components combining schedule (p6-8); Depreciation, Nutrition, Special Building, QCPUT and Activities fund schedules recorded separately. Activities and Nutrition detail receipt lines include fund transfers as other financing (inside printed receipt totals). Student activities receipts (86,823) are shown in Other Governmental Funds. Pages: p1 = report p4, p2 = p5, p3 = p6, p4 = p7, p5 = p8, p6-8 = p22-24, p9-20 = p28-39.
